statement: Only its author abandons a change that revokes a break-glass binding that still grants; anyone else, the principal it revokes included, is refused (403, or 404 for one who may not see the change). Every abandon is recorded as an ABANDONED change event; a break-glass change's abandon needs a REQUIRED change listener and is recorded there before it is stored.
guards: control:BreakGlassControlTest#only its author abandons a revoke of a live binding
control:BreakGlassControlTest#abandoning any other change is recorded after, best effort
